changelog: Board toolbars (#3838): the selected Mine/Team button (and four other dark buttons) pin their dark-mode colours, since `html.dark .bg-gray-900` beat `dark:bg-gray-100`. Sales board: Mine/Team on the left, "show empty stages" and the search right-aligned in the same row. Admin board: saved views, owner filter, "hide empty stages" and the search in one right-aligned row above the colleague strip. A collapsed empty-stage strip keeps its stage colour without the 4px top stripe.

en: Boards: the Mine/Team switch is readable in dark mode, filters and the search share one row above the colleague strip, and empty stage strips look tidier.
tr: Panolar: Benim/Ekip seçimi koyu temada okunuyor, filtreler ve arama ekip arkadaşları şeridinin üstünde tek satırda, boş aşama şeritleri daha düzgün görünüyor.
de: Boards: Der Schalter Meine/Team ist im dunklen Modus lesbar, Filter und Suche stehen in einer Zeile über der Kollegenleiste, leere Phasen-Streifen wirken aufgeräumter.
